import importlib.util
programs = Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out-2/play/users/u059/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
path = programs / 'task-6ec8859d.py'
source = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    base = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v in (2, 8) for v in row)), None)
    if base is None:
        return out
    for c, value in enumerate(grid[base]):
        if value in (2, 8):
            rise = 4 if value == 2 else 3
            top = base - rise
            for r in range(top + 1, base):
                out[r][c] = 1
            if top >= 0:
                out[top][c] = value
    return out
'''
